items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 8 June 2026 4:21am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 08 June 2026 at 4:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind later.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving complex low to the northwest of the British Isles.


##Wind##

Mainly west 3 or 4, occasional 5, backing southwest this afternoon, increasing 4 or 5 later, then 5 or 6 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mostly moderate tonight.


##Weather##

Rain in the east & middle of the area at first, soon mainly fair this morning, then scattered showers spreading from the west later this afternoon & evening, possibly becoming more widespread for a while tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in precipitation.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 5 or 6, veering west 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Mostly moderate, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate.
